summary: Full backend regression (18 pytest cases, 100% pass) plus end-to-end UI validation of every requested flow (login, overview, clients, register, master data, import wizard, audit trail, team panel, logout). All tests pass; no critical issues found.

issues: Active client selection is not persisted across a hard page reload — App defaults to clients[0], which can be confusing after refresh on a non-first client. Suggest persisting active client id in localStorage.

action_items: Optional UX polish: persist active client id (localStorage) so refresh keeps the same workspace open.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py `changeTarget` in ImportWizard.jsx currently clears the mapping when the user switches target — consider re-running guess_mapping on the frontend for the new target (currently only initial suggestion is populated).
Frontend Dashboard.jsx does not surface API errors — silently sets stats={} on failure. Consider a small error toast for observability.
CORS is configured with `allow_origins=[FRONTEND_URL or '*']` and `allow_credentials=True`. Wildcard with credentials is browser-rejected; ensure FRONTEND_URL is always set in production.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up a UITest_* client during UI run; backend tests create + delete TEST_ prefixed clients and members via fixtures.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and cover auth (login/logout/me/pending/suspended), owner admin (requests/users/limit/status), clients CRUD + isolation (random client 404), obligations seed+update, master data CRUD (directors/auditors/financials), imports preview+apply (with required-field skip), audit log content, dashboard, reminders. UI selectors: login uses `auth-email-input`, `auth-password-input`, `auth-submit-button`. Nav buttons are `nav-{dashboard|clients|register|master|imports|audit|approvals}-button`. Register selectors are keyed by obligation id (`obligation-{id}-status|expand|srn|remarks|filed|assignee`). Import sheet ids use the sheet name verbatim (`import-target-Directors`, `import-map-Directors-name`, `import-apply-Directors`).
